places.quote: Riah the Jew once more came forth into Saint Mary Axe.
He passed over London Bridge, and returned to the Middlesex shore by that of Westminster

places.normalized: North bank of the Thames, Middlesex, London
places.quote: returned to the Middlesex shore by that of Westminster
places.note: Refers to the northern bank; Middlesex was a county, so location is approximate.

places.quote: Thus conversing, and having crossed Westminster Bridge, they traversed the ground
places.note: Written as 'that of Westminster' earlier; listed once under the clearer form.

places.quote: when they had recrossed the Thames by way of London Bridge
There's a Drawing Room, or a grand day in the Park, or a Show
places.note: Presumed to be Hyde Park; the passage does not name it outright.

places.normalized: Six Jolly Fellowship Porters tavern, Limehouse, London
places.quote: Riah asked the way to a certain tavern called the Six Jolly Fellowship Porters.
places.note: Real tavern on Limehouse Hole, near the river; the novel's setting is in Limehouse.
